title: Top 10 Best Mobile Apps to Make Money in India 2026
summary: Top 10 best mobile apps to make money in India 2026: commission, skill and reward apps compared with honest earnings, payouts, and how to start on each.
body_markdown:
Your phone is already a money-making machine. The question is which apps deserve space on it. Most lists of the best mobile apps to make money mix three very different things without telling you: **commission apps** that pay hundreds to thousands of rupees per action, **skill apps** that pay for what you know or create, and **reward apps** that pay pocket money for taps and opinions. Knowing which tier you are in changes everything about what to expect.


This guide ranks the 10 best money earning apps in India for 2026 (an evolution of our earlier[earn money online mobile app picks](https://gromo.in/blog/earn-money-online-mobile-app/) ) across all three tiers, with honest monthly figures, payout details, and how to start on each. Every app here is free to join and belongs on any list of[legitimate apps to earn money](https://gromo.in/blog/top-legitimate-apps-to-earn-money-in-2026/) : a genuine earn money online mobile app never charges a fee, and anything that asks for a deposit to unlock earnings is a scam, not an app.


## 1. GroMo - Commissions on Financial Products


**Tier: commission | Earning: Rs 5,000-30,000+/month | Payout: bank account, after each approved application**


GroMo sits at the top because it changes the unit of earning. Reward apps pay Rs 2-20 per task; GroMo pays Rs 500-2,000+ per approved referral, because you are helping people get real financial products: savings accounts, credit cards, loans, and demat accounts from[India's leading banks](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) . Help one friend get a credit card and you have earned more than a month of survey-filling, from the same phone, in a fraction of the time.


The deeper insight: commission apps reward trust, not taps. Your contact list, society group, and college network are assets no reward app can monetise, and every satisfied customer returns for their next product. GroMo adds free training, so you learn how credit scores, insurance, and demat accounts actually work while earning from that knowledge.


**How to start on GroMo:**


1. Download the GroMo app and register free with your phone number.
2. Complete the quick verification and free in-app training.
3. Pick a product and share its application link with someone who needs it.
4. Track the application in the app; the commission credits after approval.


## 2. EarnKaro - Turn Deal-Sharing into Income


**Tier: commission | Earning: Rs 1,000-15,000/month | Payout: bank transfer**


EarnKaro converts any product link from major shopping sites into your personal profit link. Share deals in WhatsApp and Telegram groups, and you earn a commission whenever someone buys. No KYC, no investment, phone-only. The people who win at EarnKaro treat it like a tiny media business: one niche (say, kitchen deals or fashion under Rs 500), one audience, daily consistency.


## 3. CashKaro - Cashback on Shopping You Already Do


**Tier: commission (passive) | Earning: Rs 200-2,000/month, more for heavy shoppers | Payout: bank, UPI, gift cards**


CashKaro pays real cashback when you route your normal Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Ajio orders through its app. It is the lowest-effort entry on this list: same shopping, extra money back. Its[refer-and-earn](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-earn-2026-legit-apps/) adds 10% of your friends' cashback earnings for life, which quietly compounds if your family shops through your link.


## 4. Meesho - Reselling Without Inventory


**Tier: commission | Earning: Rs 3,000-20,000/month | Payout: bank account**


Meesho lets you run a boutique from your phone: share catalogue products with your margin added, and the platform handles delivery, payment, and returns. Zero stock, zero risk. The skill is curation: resellers who know their audience's taste and share a focused selection consistently outsell those who forward entire catalogues to every group.


## 5. Google Opinion Rewards - The Most Trustworthy Micro-Earner


**Tier: reward | Earning: Rs 50-500/month | Payout: Google Play credit**


Google itself asks 10-30 second questions and pays per answer. The amounts are small and arrive as Play credit rather than cash, but it is completely safe, takes seconds, and funds your apps and subscriptions. Perfect proof that earning from your phone is real, before you climb to bigger tiers.


## 6. Sikka - Surveys and Daily Tasks with Low Minimums


**Tier: reward | Earning: Rs 500-5,000/month | Payout: Paytm, bank transfer, recharge; minimum around Rs 100**


Sikka bundles surveys, video tasks, and daily missions with one of the lowest payout minimums in the category, so you see real money quickly instead of chasing a distant threshold. Casual users report Rs 500-1,500 a month; active users touch Rs 2,000-5,000. Treat it as structured pocket money in dead time.


## 7. Chillar - Micro-Tasks and Referrals


**Tier: reward | Earning: Rs 400-4,000/month | Payout: UPI, minimum around Rs 50**


Chillar is a[complete-task-and-earn app](https://gromo.in/blog/complete-task-and-earn-money/) paying for small tasks, app installs, and referrals, with payouts that clear in a few days. The referral layer is where it stretches: sharing with friends who will actually use it turns a Rs 500 month into a Rs 2,000-4,000 month. As with all task apps, never install anything that demands unnecessary permissions.


## 8. Toloka - AI Micro-Tasks from Your Phone


**Tier: skill | Earning: Rs 2,000-12,000/month | Payout: digital wallets, dollar-based**


Toloka pays for the tasks that train AI systems: labelling images, checking search results, verifying translations. It is the most future-facing app on this list, and Indian-language tasks give local users a real edge. Accuracy matters: your rating decides which higher-paying task queues unlock. A phone works; a laptop makes you faster.


## 9. Chegg and Doubt-Solving Apps - Get Paid for What You Know


**Tier: skill | Earning: Rs 5,000-20,000/month | Payout: per answer or per session**


If you are strong in maths, science, or coding, doubt-solving platforms pay per question answered from your phone, whenever you are free. It is pay-for-output with zero schedule, which makes it the best skill-tier fit for students and anyone with sharp subject knowledge and scattered free time.


## 10. Funngro - Real Projects for Teen Talent


**Tier: skill | Earning: Rs 1,000-10,000/month | Payout: bank account**


Funngro connects young talent with companies for real projects: content, design, social media, research. It fills a genuine gap, giving teenagers a legitimate, parent-friendly way to earn from skills before most platforms will onboard them. Portfolios built here convert into serious freelance rates later.


## The Honest Math of Money Earning Apps


- **Reward tier (Google Opinion Rewards, Sikka, Chillar):** Rs 500-5,000 a month. Real, instant, small. Use dead time, never prime time.
- **Skill tier (Toloka, Chegg, Funngro):** Rs 2,000-20,000 a month. Pay tracks ability and consistency, and the skill itself compounds.
- **Commission tier (GroMo, EarnKaro, CashKaro, Meesho):** Rs 3,000-30,000+ a month. Pay tracks trust and network, the two assets that grow as you use them.
- **The upgrade path most people miss:** start in the reward tier to prove earning works, add a skill app that fits you, then let a commission app become your main earner. Same phone, ten times the outcome.


The best mobile app to make money is the one matched to what you have: spare minutes, a skill, or a network people trust. Prove it to yourself with a survey app this week, then aim higher. If you already have people who take your recommendations seriously, skip straight to the top of this list:[download GroMo](https://gromo.in/?ref=gromo.in) , finish the free training, and turn that trust into your first bank-paid commission.


## FAQ: Mobile Apps to Make Money


**Which is the best mobile app to make money in India?**


It depends on your biggest asset. If people trust your recommendations, GroMo pays the most: Rs 500-2,000+ per approved financial product referral, reaching Rs 5,000-30,000+ monthly. If you have a skill, Chegg-style doubt-solving and Toloka pay for knowledge and accuracy. If you only have spare minutes, Google Opinion Rewards, Sikka, and Chillar pay small but reliably.


**How can I earn money on phone apps without investment?**


Every app in this guide is free: download from the official app store, register with your phone or email, and start earning from surveys, tasks, deal-sharing, reselling, or product referrals. Payouts go to UPI, bank, or gift cards. The only rule: never pay a joining fee or deposit, and never share OTPs; genuine apps need nothing but your time.


**How much money can I realistically make from my phone?**


Reward apps pay Rs 500-5,000 a month for spare-time use. Skill apps like Toloka and doubt-solving platforms pay Rs 2,000-20,000 depending on ability and hours. Commission apps scale highest: EarnKaro deal-sharers report Rs 1,000-15,000, Meesho resellers Rs 3,000-20,000, and consistent GroMo partners Rs 5,000-30,000+. Most people roughly triple their first-month figure by month three.


**Are money earning apps safe and legit?**


The ten here are legitimate: free to join, run by verifiable companies, with published payout methods and minimums. Judge any other app by the same test, and avoid real-cash gaming apps that blur into gambling, apps demanding deposits to unlock earnings, and APKs shared through Telegram or WhatsApp instead of official stores.


**Which app pays real money instantly?**


Task and survey apps come closest: Chillar and Sikka have low minimums (around Rs 50-100) with payouts clearing to UPI in 1-5 days, and Google Opinion Rewards credits Play balance instantly. Bigger earners run on approval cycles: GroMo commissions credit after the bank approves an application, and EarnKaro confirms commissions after return windows close. Faster is not better; larger is better.

GroMo commissions are set by the partner banks and financial institutions, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission in the GroMo app before relying on any figure.
